title: On Observing the birds for three seasons
subtitle: 文化遗产 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）
meta: 主题语境：文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）　|　核心词汇：observe　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 observe 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the grandmother ① observed the birds for three seasons without a word of thanks, and every child in the courtyard said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grandmother ② observes the birds for three seasons at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ observe the birds for three seasons at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ observed the birds for three seasons before — a line in the diary for February 1986 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Observing the birds for three seasons without a word of thanks, the grandmother said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ observe the old feasts faithfully at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Observe the old feasts faithfully at once and never mention it again.

By 1999 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the diary, and a new child from the next courtyard ⑧ observes the old feasts faithfully without a word of thanks every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the window, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ observed the birds for three seasons again when nobody else would.

⑩ To observe the birds for three seasons, my mother said in 2004, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the courtyard remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the courtyard forgets, somebody observes the birds for three seasons at once again and somebody must observe the birds for three seasons without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 观察（一般过去式 observed the birds for three seasons：1992 年祖母头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 观察（一般现在 observes the birds for three seasons：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 观察（不定式 to observe the birds for three seasons：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 观察（过去完成时 had observed the birds for three seasons：1986 年二月的日记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 观察（动名词 observing the birds for three seasons 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 遵守（observe the old feasts faithfully：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去遵守一如既往地守那些旧节）
G. v. 遵守（observe the old feasts faithfully：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 观察（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 observes the old feasts faithfully，而母亲又一次 observed the birds for three seasons）

observe 意为“观察”，自那以后祖母二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 observes。
observe 意为“观察”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯观察把那些鸟观察了三个季节”，此处为不定式 to observe the birds for three seasons。
observe 意为“观察”，日记里 二月 那行字说明早在 1999 年之前就有人观察过，故用过去完成时 had observed。
observe 意为“观察”，祖母说“观察把那些鸟观察了三个季节这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 observing the birds for three seasons 作主语。
observe 意为“遵守”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去遵守一如既往地守那些旧节”，should ever 之后用原形 observe the old feasts faithfully。
observe 意为“遵守”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻遵守一如既往地守那些旧节（observe the old feasts faithfully at once），以后再也不要提起。
observe 意为“观察”，新来的孩子每个年头都照例遵守一如既往地守那些旧节，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 observes。
observe 意为“观察”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢观察把那些鸟观察了三个季节，用一般过去式 observed 叙述。
observe 意为“观察”，结尾那句是母亲 2004 年的话：要观察把那些鸟观察了三个季节，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和院子记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 observe 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1992 the grandmother observed the birds for three seasons without a word of thanks, and nobody in the courtyard forgot it.
Even now the grandmother observes the birds for three seasons at once whenever the courtyard asks.
Observing the birds for three seasons without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever observe the old feasts faithfully at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next courtyard observes the old feasts faithfully without a word of thanks every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother observed the birds for three seasons again, and the courtyard remembered that half.
